runtimeMapping.normal: Source SELF/timing0/alwaysIncludeTarget1 preserves a still-legal input while refreshing current ground victims at release; cap is current block count, zero cap allowed to produce none. Original .333 event, maxAnimScale2; native S1 uses cap1 and selected atk_scale with offensive SP.
runtimeMapping.s2: SP_FULL auto activation without enemy requirement. Selected permanent ATK/DEF and source grid2-2; original Skill_1_Begin holds ordinary attacks, then original Skill_1 .6 event and idle; maxAnimScale2. No manual cancel.
runtimeMapping.s3: Full maintained sequence: eight real-time one-second ground-only base-range slices, current legal membership refreshed for each, with selected ATK/DEF ramp; ninth-second selected maximum bonus, native direct PURE self loss then ALL-motion Physical burst in grid3-6; tenth-second cleanup. Fixed continuous clock is independent of ASPD and basic block-count cap. The recovered Front Begin alias is speed1.75 and End visual starts at7s, preceding the mapped delayed burst by the literal2s.
runtimeMapping.ramp: Inverse remaining-time ATK/DEF percentage uses selected duration minus native endTime1.05 as denominator at each one-second pulse, then explicit maximum before the ninth-second burst. Native time origin and animation quantization remain unverified.
runtimeMapping.talents: E1+ deploy-time undeadable until first HP ratio <= selected threshold. Heal selected current MAX HP fraction with ordinary heal restrictions and modifiers, remove undeadable, then selected-duration damage-only half-HP floor. E2 resistance activates at selected12/15 seconds and uses exact pinned status_resistance[inf] highest-only identity.

verificationLimits: The native ContinuousAttack preDelay1.4/postDelayChecker2 and animation delaySecond2 overlap are retained exactly. PRTS authored mechanics notes provide the eight slices / ninth-second finisher schedule, replacing the prior unsupported whole-kit deferral. This is an explicit measured-mechanics mapping, not a recovered C# clock or game-frame certification. Sub-second pulse/finisher alignment remains unverified.

RemainingRatioToAttributeModifier is mapped to selected ATK/DEF percentages and duration-endTime at each native one-second buff trigger, reaching maximum at the finisher. Compiled ratio aggregation, duration origin, native frame rounding and same-frame ordering are not executable-recovered.

S3 controlled interruption cancels unissued slices and its finisher without refund. The literal control epoch latches accepted brief controls. Native maintained-state resumption or interruption-to-End-animation dispatch is not recovered.

The end clip contains eight OnAttack events that do not schedule eight extra attacks: the native continuous damage clock and delayed skill-finish event own damage. Missing Back aliases resolve to the original Skill_2_End and missing Down clips are not synthesized.

Talent1 uses <= from the original useLTForMax0 predicate despite the translated description saying beneath. The heal runs before the undead mark clears and before the damage-only floor attaches. Foreign healing, nested receipts and same-tick external HP modification timing remain local ordered mappings.

The S3 self cost uses direct PURE/NORMAL skipModifierEvent with a per-receipt nonlethal floor. It bypasses shield, dodge, invulnerability and damage reduction; it still enters damage callbacks, can trigger the unused talent, and is distinct from HPLOSS.

Native normal/S1/S2 selector, physical modifier aggregation and attack animation playback rate are mapped in the shared engine; source unit-body collision is used for the forward3x3 burst, but native boundary precision is not game-frame verified.
Original particles, chainsaw VFX, sounds and module upgrades remain unimplemented. Source references and exact original Front/Back assets are preserved.

notes: The authored mechanics note records one ground strike per second during the first eight seconds, then a ninth-second maximum-stat update, self loss and a collision-tested burst in the forward 3x3 grid that can hit air.
The ordinary trait cap follows block count, and the second skill uses its provided grid rather than a generic range extension.
The first talent begins with undeadable and checks HP at or below one quarter; the locked half-HP floor applies to damage receipts.
